en.headline: MTR Island Line signalling fault causes rush-hour delays near HKU
en.dek: A fault near HKU station forced slower running and added five to eight minutes to end-to-end journeys on Wednesday morning; services resumed after repairs around 10:30.
body: The MTR Corporation said a signalling equipment fault near HKU station disrupted Island Line services during Wednesday morning rush hour.

Trains passing the affected section had to slow down, extending overall journey times between Kennedy Town and Chai Wan by an estimated five to eight minutes. Long queues formed at North Point station as passengers waited for trains.

The operator advised commuters to allow extra time. Maintenance crews completed repairs by about 10:30, after which services gradually returned to normal. By mid-morning the fault had been cleared and trains were running on regular schedules again.

zh.headline: 港島線港大站附近信號故障 早高峰延誤近兩小時
zh.dek: 周三早上港大站附近信號設備故障令列車慢駛，來回行車時間多五至八分鐘，北角站出現人龍，約十時半修復後服務逐步回復。
body: 港鐵公司表示，周三早上繁忙時間港島線因香港大學站附近信號設備故障而受阻。
受影響路段列車需要慢駛，由堅尼地城至柴灣的整體行車時間預計多五至八分鐘。北角站月台出現長龍，有乘客表示等候多時才能上車。
港鐵呼籲乘客預留充裕時間。維修人員約於上午十時半完成修復，列車服務其後陸續回復正常。
